description: Draft phase-0 shared definitions. No public mailbox records. Policy and byte encodings are in design.md.

hpkeSuite.description: RFC 9180 HPKE suite tuple using IANA numeric identifiers. Unknown suites validate structurally but require implementation support.

aad.description: HPKE metadata. Canonical AAD binds envelope version, suite, enc and this object. See design.md.

messageId.description: Sender DID plus TID is the immutable idempotency key.

recipientKeyId.description: DID URL of recipient's keyAgreement key; checked against recipientDid.

expiresAt.description: Absent means no expiry; never infer expiry from the TID.

encryptedEnvelope.description: Sign-then-encrypt envelope; appSignature over canonicalSigningBytes is encrypted inside ciphertext. Not an atproto record signature.

enc.description: HPKE encapsulated key, not a nonce.

ciphertext.description: HPKE encryption of signedMessage, including appSignature.

deliveryState.description: Open values: accepted = durable admission; queued = awaiting runtime; delivered = injected into leased runtime, not processed; acked = recipient acknowledgment; expired = sender-set expiry reached; failed = terminal failure with a receipt. Unknown values are not success.

messageRef.description: Sender DID plus TID identity, with optional future repository locators.

uri.description: Optional actual persisted record URI; never fabricate a phase-0 record locator.

cid.description: Optional CID of that exact persisted record, not a hash of JSON.

appSignature.description: App-specific encrypted signature over canonicalSigningBytes. Not a repo commit signature.

keyId.description: DID URL of sender's authorized signing key at send time.

publicKeyMultibase.description: Optional historical key hint, never authority without verified key history.

signedMessage.description: HPKE plaintext encoded as DRISL-CBOR. canonicalSigningBytes is the domain-separated canonical encoding of signingPayload, not JSON.

signingPayload.description: Payload following the Rat King signature domain prefix. Metadata must match the envelope; body contains application bytes.

operator.description: Public operator namespace label, not a private person name.

project.description: Public project namespace at birth, not the current assignment.

receipt.description: Sequenced receipt in the recipient's private log. State transitions append events, never overwrite history.

detail.description: Optional public-safe failure or expiry explanation.

woke.description: Independent best-effort wake outcome, never proof of delivery.

messageEvent.description: Message admission event; seq equals receipt.seq. Later transitions are separate receiptEvent objects.

receiptEvent.description: Delivery transition event; seq equals receipt.seq.
